$comment: Demo prompts persisted as inputs for building demo websites. Each build produced from these prompts serves as testing evidence for pipeline/theme changes. Build them all with: php bin/build-demos.php (or just one with --only=<slug>). An entry may carry a canonical `site_spec` object (see examples/site-spec.json): it is pre-seeded into the project's meta.json, so the site-spec step normalizes it deterministically instead of generating one via LLM — exercising the host-supplied-spec path of BIGR-754.

prompts.prompt: Create a minimalist website for my photo-journalism portfolio. I'm an Argentinean photo-journalist based in Buenos Aires. I covered the most important social and political events of the country in the last 20 years.
Create a website for my classic Georgian restautant called "Tbilisi Tavern" it's a traditional resutaurant located in Tbilisi Old Town and it serves classic gerorgian and caucasus dishes.

Create a website for my vegetarian restaurant called "Naturaleza Sabia" located in the old San Telmo neighborhood in Buenos Aires, Argentina. We serve vegetarian versions of Argentinean traditional dishes. Everything should be in english, our restaurant website is for international tourists.

Create a warm, editorial website for Lumen Objects, a small Copenhagen studio that makes sculptural table lamps from recycled glass. The site should showcase the current collection, explain the hand-blown production process, and invite interior designers to request a trade catalogue.

Create a clean, confident website for Atlas Field, a mobile app for independent construction crews. It helps them schedule jobs, track materials, share daily site reports, and keep clients updated. The audience is owner-operators and small contractors; the main goal is to get visitors to start a free trial.

Create a website for an electronic music festival in Stockholm's art district: two nights of DJs, immersive installations, and daytime workshops. The design must be unmistakably vaporwave, trendy and futuristic.

prompts.$comment: Tests the host-supplied site spec path (BIGR-754): site_spec below is pre-seeded into meta.json, so the site-spec step makes no LLM call for this build. The spec mirrors the canonical contract example in examples/site-spec.json.
prompts.prompt: Create a warm, honest website for Hearth & Crumb, a neighborhood bakery in Portland, Maine that specializes in naturally leavened bread and seasonal pastries. Show the daily selection, explain the slow fermentation process, and make it easy to find the shop and its opening hours.

site_spec.name: Hearth & Crumb
site_spec.title: Bread Made Slowly, Shared Daily
site_spec.description: A neighborhood bakery specializing in naturally leavened bread and seasonal pastries.

pages.title: Home
pages.purpose: Introduce the bakery, highlight the daily selection, and direct visitors to ordering and location details.

pages.title: Menu
pages.purpose: Present the bakery's current breads and pastries.

children.title: Bread
children.purpose: List naturally leavened loaves with ingredients and availability.

children.title: Pastries
children.purpose: List seasonal pastries with ingredients and availability.

pages.title: Visit
pages.purpose: Provide the bakery's address, opening hours, and contact details.
